description: Defines the KANDA routing system as a context-selection operating system: Prompt-Call Accuracy, Context Package Manifest, Prompt Registration v2, advisory similarity boundaries, freeze-aware routing, startup boot discipline, and no global prompt injection.
trigger_phrases: register prompt as routable context asset
user_intent_examples: Update the way prompts are registered into the routing system.
Define the Context Package Manifest before routing automation.
Review whether this task needs Fast Path or Routed Work Path context.
when_to_load: When routing-system behavior, prompt-call accuracy, context package manifests, prompt registration, startup routing, or routing indexes are being audited, changed, canonized, or frozen.
when_not_to_load: Do not load for simple Fast Path explanations, small rewrites, ordinary code patches with an already-clear route, or as a substitute for specialist prompts after routing is decided.
